actual_service_job_environment_group_lis.limitation: no authenticated Render metadata or sanitized receipt

actual_environment_secret_file_names.limitation: no live env/group/file names; public source references only

current_retained_deploy_images.limitation: historical source revision available, current runtime/digest unknown

native_schedules_background_callers_and_.limitation: three GitHub manual jobs known, Render-native jobs/current callers/state not known

manual_workflow_history.limitation: GitHub history only; actual target URL/credential presence/current enablement not proven
